# laravel-subscriptions

> Payment-provider-agnostic subscription billing core with plans, trials, calendar-anchored periods, exact integer proration and sequential invoices, ready for a Laravel adapter Composer package `trysac/u950-laravel-subscriptions`, namespace `Trysac\LaravelSubscriptions`, MIT
> licensed, PHP >= 8.4, standard library only.
